name: Inu-domo no Jigoku
source:
Hero visits an inn in the town for the first time in 20 years. 20 years ago a tragedy happened there and he's interested in reinvigorating old memories. However, he can also make new memories with pretty girls of the inn.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公时隔20年再次造访小镇上的旅馆。20年前那里发生了一场悲剧，他想重温旧日记忆。不过，他也可以和旅馆里的漂亮女孩们创造新的回忆。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
